# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Pidgeon is a very lenient teacher who maintains poor discipline, often allowing his students to talk, eat, and play games in class. He is prone to ignoring his younger pupils while focusing heavily on older students preparing for examinations. At times, he displays spite, sarcasm, and solemn self-importance when reprimanding students, though he also shows a degree of imagination and sentimentality.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolteacher at the Brierley schoolhouse. During his tenure, he focused much of his instruction on older students like Sukey Pullen while largely ignoring younger children. He frequently disciplined pupils like Nell Harcourt by making them stand at the front of the room, while overlooking minor misconduct from others. Under the guise of assisting Sukey with her studies for the Regent's examination, he visited her home almost every night. On a school outing, he gathered Mayflowers and presented them to Sukey. At the end of the term, he delivered an emotional parting speech to his class before leaving his teaching position.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_
